import torch, json
from transformers import AutoModelForSequenceClassification
from peft import PeftModel
from safetensors.torch import load_file
import glob, os

A="dominguesm/xlm-roberta-base-lora-language-detection"
head = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(A, num_labels=20)
hs = head.state_dict()
for k in hs:
    if "classifier" in k: print("adapter:",k,tuple(hs[k].shape))

print("---- merged model files")

print("---- model_cache files")

    if "classifier" in k: print("merged:",k,tuple(sd[k].shape))

print("merged==adapter(bias):", eq(sd["classifier.out_proj.bias"], hs["classifier.modules_to_save.default.out_proj.bias"]))

from transformers import AutoModelForSequenceClassification, AutoTokenizer
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("/app/merged_model")
m = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained("/app/merged_model").eval()

cases = {
 "fr": ["Bonjour, comment allez-vous aujourd'hui?","Je m'appelle Pierre et j'habite à Paris.","Le chat est sur la table.","Nous allons au marché demain matin.","C'est une très belle journée."],
 "es": ["Hola, ¿cómo estás hoy?","Me llamo Juan y vivo en Madrid.","El perro corre por el parque.","Vamos a la playa este fin de semana.","Es un día muy bonito."],
 "de": ["Guten Tag, wie geht es Ihnen?","Ich heiße Anna und wohne in Berlin.","Die Katze schläft auf dem Sofa.","Wir fahren morgen in den Urlaub.","Das ist ein sehr schöner Tag."],
 "it": ["Ciao, come stai oggi?","Mi chiamo Marco e vivo a Roma.","Il cane corre nel parco.","Andiamo al mare questo fine settimana.","È una giornata molto bella."],
 "pt": ["Olá, como você está?","Meu nome é João e moro em Lisboa.","O gato está dormindo no sofá.","Vamos à praia no fim de semana.","É um dia muito bonito."],
 "ru": ["Привет, как дела?","Меня зовут Иван, я живу в Москве.","Собака бежит по парку.","Мы поедем на море в выходные.","Сегодня очень хороший день."],
 "ja": ["こんにちは、お元気ですか？","私の名前は田中です。東京に住んでいます。","猫はソファで寝ています。","週末に海に行きます。","今日はとてもいい天気です。"],
 "zh": ["你好，你好吗？","我叫李明，住在北京。","猫在沙发上睡觉。","我们周末去海边。","今天天气非常好。"],
 "ar": ["مرحبا، كيف حالك؟","اسمي أحمد وأنا أعيش في القاهرة.","الكلب يجري في الحديقة.","سنذهب إلى الشاطئ في نهاية الأسبوع.","الجو جميل جدا اليوم."],
 "en": ["Hello, how are you?","My name is John and I live in London.","The dog is running in the park.","We are going to the beach this weekend.","It is a very nice day today."],
}
with torch.no_grad():
    for lang, sents in cases.items():
        ids=[]
        for s in sents:
            logits=m(**tok(s,return_tensors="pt",truncation=True)).logits
            p=torch.softmax(logits,-1)[0]
            ids.append((int(p.argmax()), round(float(p.max()),4)))
        labs=[i for i,_ in ids]
        ok = len(set(labs))==1
        print(f"{lang}: {'CONSISTENT' if ok else 'INCONSISTENT'} -> {ids}")
